watch.en: Let it cook down until it reaches the thickness you want.
watch.de: Einkochen lassen, bis es die gewünschte Dichte hat.

why.en: As steam escapes, what remains concentrates: the sauce thickens and the flavour gets stronger.
why.de: Wenn Dampf entweicht, wird der Rest konzentrierter: Die Sauce dickt ein und der Geschmack wird kräftiger.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.3 Sauces and Thickening Agents, section Reduction
sources.sentence: Sauces are often finished by allowing them to reduce until the desired consistency is reached.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
